caption: The drawing shows a rectangular piece of light beige or off-white fabric featuring an embroidered or drawn design. The composition consists of a repeating pattern of floral motifs connected by curving and looping vines. Each flower is composed of a cluster of small petals, with some flowers appearing more dense and others more open, and they are evenly distributed throughout the central area. The vines connecting the flowers have small leaves branching out at intervals, and the entire pattern maintains a sense of symmetry and balance. The rectangular fabric is bordered by a stitched line just inside the edge, and another set of short, straight stitches runs parallel to the fabric’s edge, forming a simple frame. The drawing is done in light colors, primarily white and pale grey, making the floral and vine patterns stand out against the beige background. Small, neat text in the lower left corner reads "1" = 10 1/2". The background outside the rectangle is mostly plain and matches the base color of the rectangle.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
